objects.label: NJH Mart · Minimarket
objects.notes: Preview placement of Gerak's NJH Mart (preview/njh-step2-minimarket, from 8e099eb). 5×4 grass lot on the east side of the main N–S road, mid-block (tiles c=-29..-25, r=54..57), door faces +z / sw onto the E–W gang sidewalk at r=58. Use tile (-27, 58), use point (-26.5, 58.5). Walking distance to Kost Cove (~15 tiles north, same x) and the dock (~28 tiles via the main roads). Interior template njh_minimarket is pending (Gerak still fixing the scene) — link by id only, no scene vendored. Site id minimarket per Layar NJH-SPEC-MASAK. Billboard width/height use LFB PX/PY. Street furniture njh-atm-15/16/17 was nudged off the lot. Preview only, not live, not pushed.
